scope: Six specific primary-source records, source match evidence and rights gates; read-only

records.source_authority: U.S. Coast Guard official photo gallery
records.match_basis: exact catalog filename appears in the external image URL and the USCG record
records.rights_and_attribution_review: Official gallery states public domain and cleared for release, asks for photographer credit and DoD visual-information compliance. Photo has an identifiable person, so nonendorsement and portrait considerations still apply.
records.editorial_caution: Official gallery calls the pictured subject Anthony Pettit, while some official museum historical text lists Chief Boatswain Anthony L. Petit. Confirm spelling against service record before changing published caption.
